sources.title: Loy-s-Goodies
sources.author: Loy / SL0ANE

sources.title: Immersive Melodies
sources.author: Luke100000 and Immersive Melodies contributors
sources.modifications: 8 selected GPL-3.0 backwear models converted into Noqui native item models: static native cuboids extracted, PNG bytes copied verbatim, per-face UVs and face rotations retained, geometry recentred and uniformly scaled, and held-item transforms replaced for ItemDisplay FIXED. Sounds, playback code, and melodies are excluded.
sources.caveat: Repository GPL-3.0 covers the item models and textures. Upstream excludes sounds and the /melodies data from that licence; no sound or melody content is included or claimed. The GPL-3.0 licence text, original source models, per-asset attribution notice with the 2026-10-24 modification date, and the reproducible normalize_assets.py conversion script are retained with the adaptations.
